paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 3.16 as of October 14, 2026, with a change of -15.05% from the prior close and -33.33% over 22 sessions.

There are 2 new news items in the last 24 hours, including a headline from Yahoo! Finance Canada about FRMI put options and a story from kalkine.ca discussing why Fermi is down, mentioning Project Matador funding worries.
